observations: A head in three-quarter view fills the frame, wearing a brimmed hat split between dense red-pink scribbles on the left and grey diagonal crosshatching on the right.
The face is filled with flowing vertical bands of purple, pink, yellow, and green; a yellow-and-black spiral earring hangs near the jaw, and large reflective lenses cover the eyes.
The background is a field of soft, overlapping translucent circles in yellow, green, pink, and blue, contrasting with the heavy black contour lines of the figure.
reading: Every surface carries a different fill—tangled scribble on the hat crown, rainbow bands across the face, diagonal hatching on the brim. The spiral earring and the grid of white marks inside the red mouth feel like small puzzles nested in a larger one. Against the bubbly, pastel background, the heavy black outlines lock bright color into rigid compartments, giving the head a stained-glass quality. The mood reads as somewhere between swagger and disguise.
contextAngle: In the owned rawblocks subset, this work sits between "nnxyz rawblocks #17" and "nnxyz rawblocks #19." All three feature bold head compositions with thick black outlines, but #18 stands apart with its soft translucent background circles, while its neighbors use flat polka dots and a solid pink field.

connections.reason: Both show a close-cropped head with hat, earring, large lenses, and heavy black outlines, but #17 uses opaque white polka dots while #18 replaces them with translucent overlapping circles.
#19 exposes interior marks and a single large eye on a flat pink ground, while #18 hides the eyes behind reflective lenses—opposite approaches to revealing or concealing a face.

lookingQuestion: How do the translucent, floating circles in the background change the way you read the rigid black outlines that contain the figure?
ambiguities: The reflective shapes in the lenses could be read as a building facade or abstract hatching; the source is unclear from the image alone.
A small monogram appears in the lower-right corner, but its exact letters are difficult to confirm at this resolution.
